name: Giant Crocodile
otherStatistics: Initiative -1 (9). Proficiency Bonus +3. Senses Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: An olive-brown crocodile with a broad toothed snout, raised back scutes, and a long curled tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 356. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195016-giant-crocodile
sections.Traits: Hold Breath. The crocodile can hold its breath for 1 hour.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite and one Tail attack.
Bite. Make a +8 melee attack within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 21 (3d10 + 5) piercing damage. A Large or smaller creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 15). While held in this grapple, it is Restrained and the crocodile cannot target it with Tail.
Tail. Make a +8 melee attack within 10 ft. On a hit, deal 18 (3d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. A Large or smaller creature hit also falls Prone.

name: Giant Fire Beetle
otherStatistics: Initiative +0 (10). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 8. Languages none. Resistances Fire.
appearance: A six-legged beetle with a dark bronze shell, curved antennae, and amber light near its head.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 357. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195019-giant-fire-beetle
sections.Traits: Illumination. The beetle casts Bright Light within 10 ft., followed by another 10 ft. of Dim Light.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a +1 melee attack within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 1 fire damage.

name: Giant Frog
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Darkvision 30 ft., Passive Perception 12. Languages none.
appearance: A broad, mottled olive frog with a cream throat, golden eyes, folded hind legs, and webbed toes.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 357. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195020-giant-frog
sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The frog breathes air and water.
Standing Leap. With or without a running start, it can jump up to 20 ft. horizontally or 10 ft. vertically.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Make a +3 melee attack within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 11).
Swallow. As its action, the frog can swallow one Small or smaller target it is grappling. The target ceases to be Grappled, becomes Blinded and Restrained, and has Total Cover from attacks and other effects outside the frog. The frog cannot use Bite while the target is swallowed. If the frog dies, the target ceases to be Restrained and can spend 5 ft. of movement to escape the corpse, landing Prone. At the end of the frog’s next turn, the swallowed target takes 5 (2d4) acid damage. If it survives that damage, the frog disgorges it and it lands Prone.
sections.Published errata: The publisher’s version 1.0 errata for p. 357 changes the original +4 Bite attack bonus to +3. The digital stat block reflects the correction and retains Stealth +4 and Bite damage of 5 (1d6 + 2). https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/sae/monster-manual

name: Giant Goat
otherStatistics: Initiative +1 (11). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A heavy gray goat with coarse hair, a pointed beard, and long ridged horns that sweep back.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 357. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/4775819-giant-goat
sections.Actions: Ram. Make a +5 melee attack within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the goat moved at least 20 ft. straight toward the target immediately before the hit and the creature is Large or smaller, deal 5 (2d4) extra bludgeoning damage and knock it Prone.

name: Giant Hyena
otherStatistics: Initiative +2 (12). Proficiency Bonus +2. Senses Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 13. Languages none.
appearance: A tawny spotted hyena with a dark muzzle, rounded ears, high shoulders, and a bristled back.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, Monster Manual with the 2024 rules, p. 357. https://www.dndbeyond.com/monsters/5195021-giant-hyena
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a +5 melee attack within 5 ft. On a hit, deal 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Rampage (1/day). Immediately after damaging a creature that was already Bloodied, the hyena can move up to half its Speed, then makes one Bite attack.
